summary: This is a docs-only redispatch of a previously blocked task: it adds a dated blocker report and SUMMARY for cityline-ticketing (all 6 role logins re-tested and failing identically with a server-side 302 redirect, backed by a request/response trace and a screenshot) and rewrites PROGRESS.md to reflect this pass. No application, workflow, schema, auth, or payment code is touched, matching the tier1 profile (additive docs/new files), and the report is appropriately honest about the external blocker rather than fabricating unobserved per-role behavior, consistent with the dispatch prompt's reporting and no-duplication expectations.
issues: PROGRESS.md is fully replaced rather than appended to, deleting the previously merged history entries for the cityline-crm-billstack and cityline-contracts tasks (their completed-work summaries, credentials notes, and known-gaps lists) from this tracking file; the underlying docs/ directories for those modules are untouched so no real documentation is lost, and the old text remains recoverable via git history, but future passes should append a new dated section instead of overwriting shared cumulative state.

Login credentials (usernames and the shared password 'infi123') for all 6 ticketing roles are committed in plaintext in docs/cityline-ticketing/00-BLOCKER-login-failures-2026-07-26.md; this matches the established convention already present in prior merged commits for this reverse-engineering project (CRM/Billstack/Contracts docs), so it is not a new pattern introduced here, but is worth flagging as a standing practice to revisit given this is a QA/test sandbox tenant.
